resolutions.note: Fixed in validate() (kuroshio/core/ips/parser.py:124-129) rather than by coercing None to 0, so a typo'd friction value is reported as a malformed IPS instead of silently producing a gate that does not gate. Covers both tw_/us_ fields and both failure shapes (null, non-numeric string); bool is excluded explicitly so `true` cannot pass as int. cli.cmd_propose validates before calling propose, so the CLI path returns exit 2 with a message instead of a traceback. Orchestrator verified: validate rejects null/str/bool and accepts 0.585; CLI exits 2, no traceback; main's behaviour on the same input was ['TRIM'], so the regression is closed.
